question: How many customers do we have in total?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers FROM Customer LIMIT 1

question: List the top 10 customers by total spending, showing first name, last name, and total spent. Break spending ties by customer ID ascending.
expected_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS total_spent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY total_spent DESC, c.CustomerId ASC LIMIT 10

question: What is the total revenue by customer country, highest revenue first? Show country and total revenue; break ties by country name.
expected_sql: SELECT c.Country, SUM(i.Total) AS total_revenue FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Country ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.Country ASC LIMIT 50

question: Show the first 50 tracks by track ID ascending, with track title, album title, and artist name in that order.
expected_sql: SELECT t.Name AS track, al.Title AS album, ar.Name AS artist FROM Track t JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId ORDER BY t.TrackId ASC LIMIT 50

question: Find customers whose country is USA, showing first name, last name, and email, ordered by customer ID.
expected_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, Email FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'USA' ORDER BY CustomerId ASC LIMIT 50

question: What were the total sales in calendar year 2022?
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) AS total_sales FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2022' LIMIT 1

question: Rank artists with tracks by track count using RANK, showing artist name, track count, and rank. Return the top 50 ordered by count descending, then artist ID ascending.
expected_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(t.TrackId) DESC) AS artist_rank FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY track_count DESC, ar.ArtistId ASC LIMIT 50

question: Which purchasing customers have spent more than the average total spending per purchasing customer? Show first name, last name, and total spent.
expected_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS total_spent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId HAVING SUM(i.Total) > (SELECT AVG(customer_total) FROM (SELECT SUM(Total) AS customer_total FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId)) LIMIT 50

question: How many unique countries are our customers from?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Country) AS unique_countries FROM Customer LIMIT 1

question: What is the average track length in minutes by genre? Show genre and unrounded average minutes, longest average first, then genre name.
expected_sql: SELECT g.Name AS genre, AVG(t.Milliseconds) / 60000.0 AS avg_minutes FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId ORDER BY avg_minutes DESC, g.Name ASC LIMIT 50

question: Which 10 albums have the most tracks? Show album title, artist name, and track count, descending by count and then ascending by album ID.
expected_sql: SELECT al.Title, ar.Name AS artist, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY al.AlbumId ORDER BY track_count DESC, al.AlbumId ASC LIMIT 10

question: Show year-month and total revenue for the latest 12 months present in the invoice data, newest month first.
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS month, SUM(Total) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY month ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 12

question: List all employees and their managers as two full-name columns, using NULL for employees without a manager.
expected_sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS employee, m.FirstName || ' ' || m.LastName AS manager FROM Employee e LEFT JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId LIMIT 50

question: What is the most popular track by number of invoice-line purchases? Show track title and purchase count, breaking ties by track ID ascending.
expected_sql: SELECT t.Name AS track, COUNT(ii.InvoiceLineId) AS purchase_count FROM InvoiceLine ii JOIN Track t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY ii.TrackId ORDER BY purchase_count DESC, ii.TrackId ASC LIMIT 1

question: Show customer country, revenue, and percentage of total revenue rounded to two decimal places, ordered by revenue descending and then country ascending.
expected_sql: SELECT c.Country, SUM(i.Total) AS revenue, ROUND(SUM(i.Total) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice), 2) AS pct FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Country ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.Country ASC LIMIT 50

question: How many tracks are in each media type? Show media type name and track count, descending by count then ascending by media type name.
expected_sql: SELECT mt.Name AS media_type, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId ORDER BY track_count DESC, mt.Name ASC LIMIT 50

question: Which playlists have more than 50 tracks? Show playlist name and track count, descending by count and then ascending by playlist ID.
expected_sql: SELECT p.Name AS playlist, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId HAVING COUNT(pt.TrackId) > 50 ORDER BY track_count DESC, p.PlaylistId ASC LIMIT 50

question: As of 2026-01-01, which customers have no purchase in the preceding 12 months? Show first name, last name, and latest purchase timestamp, including customers who never purchased.
expected_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, MAX(i.InvoiceDate) AS last_purchase FROM Customer c LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId HAVING MAX(i.InvoiceDate) < date('2026-01-01', '-1 year') OR MAX(i.InvoiceDate) IS NULL LIMIT 50

question: For the earliest 50 months in the invoice data, show year-month, monthly revenue, and cumulative revenue from the start of the data, oldest month first.
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS month, SUM(Total) AS monthly_revenue, SUM(SUM(Total)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate)) AS cumulative_revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY month ORDER BY month ASC LIMIT 50

question: Find the first 50 tracks containing 'love' in the title, case insensitive. Show track title, album title, and artist name, ordered by track title then track ID ascending.
expected_sql: SELECT t.Name AS track, al.Title AS album, ar.Name AS artist FROM Track t JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE LOWER(t.Name) LIKE '%love%' ORDER BY t.Name ASC, t.TrackId ASC LIMIT 50
